title: name next organisational steps
name: Name next organisational steps
rule: Name the next organisational steps — e.g. case number, who acts, how the person hears back. (Contact-channel pages not filed.)
pass_when: Confirmation names what happens next: case number and/or who acts and/or how the person hears back.
fail_when: Confirmation has no next organisational step (no case number, actor, or how they hear back).
overview: Confirmation names next organisational steps such as case number, who acts, and how they hear back.
apply_when: Writing post-submit confirmation after a request or case is created.
not_when: Not for mid-form progress text that is not a final confirmation.
agent_hint: On confirmation, name case number, actor, and how the person hears back.
description: After submit, confirmation should name what happens next: case number and/or who acts and/or how the person hears back. Organisational next steps turn a dead-end success into a usable handoff. Fail if confirmation has no next organisational step—no case number, actor, or hearing-back path. Apply when writing post-submit confirmation after a request or case is created.
do_not_claim: Contact-channel pages; success-what-went-through as this next-steps row.
